mechanism: Furosemide causes hypokalemia by increasing urinary potassium excretion through loop diuretic action, which potassium supplementation must counteract to prevent dangerous electrolyte depletion.
action: Monitor serum potassium levels regularly; potassium supplementation or concurrent potassium-sparing diuretic/ACE inhibitor is typically required to maintain normal potassium levels and prevent cardiac arrhythmias.
